title: House Robber II (Circular Street)
summary: Rob the most money from houses in a circle, where the first and last are neighbours: solve the straight street twice, once without the last house and once without the first.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Money in each house
inputs.note: Whole numbers from 0 to 999; the last house is next to the first.
